notes: Updates can no longer cost you data: your entire history is snapshotted to the device right before an update installs
If the app ever starts without its data, it now recovers it - from the on-device copy, or failing that from that pre-update snapshot
Fixed: a failed read of the on-device copy could previously overwrite it with empty data. An unreadable copy is now left strictly alone
Fixed: after recovering your data, the on-device copy stopped updating for the rest of that session
Fixed: an ordinary edit after a recovery was not being mirrored at all
